items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Definitely the Lee brothers and also Mr. Labatt and different people we played for.

ctx.x: We used to go, had to go on a boat.

Every Saturday, we'd go on that boat. Every Saturday, man come get us and we go, we catch the boat in the feet. We go on the yacht. Man, that pretty boat, you see. We used to go down every Saturday. So finally, we had a fella bought a one of them boats from the governor. The submarine chaser, one of them boats was chased. Yeah, yeah. Well, they bought one of them and they used to charge two dollars a head. You know what I mean? Mostly all big time people, you know. The fellas used to like to gamble and things, so…
Lots of jobs going all the time.
